company.name: STARZPLAY
company.shortDescription: STARZPLAY is a top MENA streaming service with 3M+ subscribers, 18% market share, offering diverse TV shows, movies, sports, and AVOD/FAST
company.description:
STARZPLAY is a premier streaming service in the MENA region, serving around 3 million subscribers and commanding an impressive 18% market share as of 2024. With a vast and diverse library, STARZPLAY is the go-to platform for viewers seeking high-quality entertainment tailored to the preferences of the region.

Since its launch in 2014, STARZPLAY has rapidly grown, offering subscribers a unique blend of blockbuster movies, popular TV shows, and exclusive sports content. The platform is home to some of the most beloved TV series, including "Young Sheldon," "Lost," and "Prison Break." These iconic series have captivated audiences worldwide, and their availability on STARZPLAY ensures that our subscribers have access to the best in television entertainment.

In addition to its extensive TV library, STARZPLAY features a robust selection of Hollywood’s biggest hits. Movies like "The Conjuring," "Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse," and "IT" are just a few examples of the thrilling and diverse content available to subscribers. Whether you're in the mood for spine-chilling horror, heart-pounding action, or thought-provoking dramas, STARZPLAY has something to offer everyone.

STARZPLAY is more than just a streaming service; it’s a comprehensive entertainment hub that caters to the diverse tastes of the MENA region. The platform also offers exclusive access to major sports events, such as the Cricket Asia Cup and Serie A, and has recently become the new home for UFC, bringing the excitement of live sports directly to your screen.

As part of its continued growth and innovation, STARZPLAY has introduced STARZ ON, a revolutionary service that combines AVOD (Advertising Video on Demand) and FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV). This expansion allows us to provide even more content to our viewers, catering to a wide range of viewing preferences and making entertainment accessible to everyone.
